claims.title: Maximally entangled mixed states for a fixed spectrum need not exist
claims.text: De Vicente proves that for particular rank-two two-qubit spectra no isospectral state can be converted into every other isospectral state even under non-entangling operations, a class larger than LOCC. Consequently no single state can maximise every entanglement monotone at those spectra, which answers the archived universal question in the negative.
